name: Chakra UI Vue
summary: Accessible Vue 2 component library: the Vue port of Chakra UI with style props, theming and dark mode.
description: A set of composable Vue 2 components that follow WAI-ARIA, styled by passing props (CBox, CStack) and themed through a provider; most are dark-mode compatible. Ships a Nuxt module and a webpack loader for auto-importing components. The repository is archived and read-only since September 2024.
contains: components include accordion, alert, avatar, badge, breadcrumbs, button, checkbox and progress
WAI-ARIA accessibility with keyboard interactions and dark mode
style-props system (CBox, CStack) with theme customisation
Nuxt module and webpack auto-import loader
repository archived and read-only since September 2024
